title: FixCandidate
description: One upstream bug-fix claim, normalized, with its provenance. A test hypothesis for the Farm, never evidence: the schema has no status field by design, so no producer (collector or AGY lane) can mark a claim verified. Only receipted runs recorded through POST /v1/fix-claims/{id}/runs move a claim past CLAIMED_FIX.

claimedBadVersion.description: The release the source says, or the collector infers, still carried the bug. Optional; the queue fills it from the release below the fixed one.

claim.description: What the source says was fixed, as one sentence. Shown as a quote, never parsed as truth.
